description: `cli service capabilities` prints the grammar, environments, variables, the exit dictionary by error code and the noun/verb index on one page; no request.

stdout.text:
OpenProse service commands: capabilities. `prose cli service capabilities --json` prints this page as one JSON document.

Usage: prose [--output human|json|jsonl] cli <command> [ARGUMENTS] [OPTIONS]
Global options such as --output go before `cli`; command options go after the command. A mistyped or misplaced word is never guessed: the command exits 2 and its error shows the corrected command to run instead.
Common options: --json, --yes, --preview, --help, --no-color.

Environment variables:
  OPENPROSE_API_KEY           API key; a non-empty value wins over the stored key.
  PROSE_OUTPUT                Output mode (human, json or jsonl) when neither --output nor --json is given.
  XDG_STATE_HOME              Base directory of the local run journal.
  PROSE_DEBUG                 Set to 1 to print a hosted run's error text as the service sent it instead of its mapped message.

Exit codes (0 is success; with --json, the error's code is in problem.code):
  0   success
  2   CONFIG_INVALID                Runner configuration is invalid.
  2   CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED         This service operation requires explicit confirmation.
  2   EXAMPLE_NOT_VIEWABLE          This example is published outside the OpenProse service and cannot be shown here.
  2   INVOCATION_INVALID            Runner invocation is invalid.
  10  CREDENTIAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE  The operating system credential store is unavailable.
  10  DEVICE_AUTH_EXPIRED           Device authorization expired. Retryable.
  10  DEVICE_AUTH_FAILED            Device authorization failed.
  10  GITHUB_LINK_REQUIRED          This operation needs a linked GitHub account on the OpenProse account.
  10  SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED     The OpenProse account is suspended.
  10  SERVICE_AUTH_REQUIRED         OpenProse service authentication is required.
  10  SERVICE_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT  The OpenProse wallet balance is insufficient for this operation.
  10  SERVICE_FEATURE_DISABLED      This capability is not available for this account.
  10  SERVICE_PREMIUM_MODEL_LOCKED  This model is a premium model that unlocks with any wallet top-up.
  10  SERVICE_PROTOCOL_INVALID      The OpenProse service returned an invalid response.
  10  SERVICE_REQUEST_REJECTED      The OpenProse service rejected the request.
  10  SERVICE_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND    The requested OpenProse service resource was not found.
  10  SERVICE_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE    The OpenProse service response exceeded the client limit.
  10  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE           The OpenProse service is unavailable. Retryable.
  10  SERVICE_WRITE_CONFLICT        The OpenProse service reported a conflicting write.
  21  HOSTED_RUN_DETACHED           The client stopped following the hosted run before its outcome arrived; the run was not cancelled.
  21  SERVICE_WATCH_DEADLINE        The watch deadline elapsed before the hosted run finished; the run continues.
  22  HOSTED_RUN_FAILED             The hosted run finished without completing successfully.
  22  RUN_SUBMISSION_AMBIGUOUS      The run submission could not be confirmed and was not repeated.
  24  CANCELLED                     The runner was cancelled before semantic completion. Retryable.
  24  HOSTED_RUN_CANCELLED          The hosted run was cancelled on the service and will not continue.
  70  INTERNAL_ERROR                The runner encountered an internal fault.

Commands:
  auth                        login, logout, status.
  example                     list, show.
  job                         configure, contract attach, contract detach, contract list, create, delete, deliveries, list, rotate-secret, show, update.
  model                       list.
  org                         create, default, invitation accept, invitation revoke, invite, list, member list, member remove, member role, rename, show.
  package                     fetch, list, publish, withdraw.
  program                     delete, draft, list, revisions, save, show, visibility.
  repo                        list.
  result                      list, publish, show, unpublish.
  run                         cancel, download, input, list, quote, share, show, submit, watch.
  service                     capabilities, guide, operations, status, triage.
  wallet                      balance, events, redeem, topup, usage.

Run `prose cli <COMMAND> --help` for one command, `prose cli service operations` for every command with its effect and usage, and `prose cli service operations --json` for every command as JSON.
